patch.value: GH-974: merge receipt preferred contradicts retained side under stable_value_order

Track GitHub issue #974: merge receipts emit top-level preferred=ours even when deterministic stable_value_order retains theirs, so structured agent consumers receive a self-contradictory outcome despite retained/discarded values being truthful.

SDK and CLI receipts expose truthful requested preference and per-decision retained side; both merge directions converge and report the same value without contradictory fields; compatibility and merge-safety tests cover scalar equality and unequal values
Create two branches that assign different priority values, merge in both directions, and compare preferred against decisions[].ours/theirs/retained/discarded.
Receipts distinguish requested preference from the actual retained side and remain internally consistent for direction-independent resolution.
preferred is always ours while stable_value_order can retain theirs.
Agents can wrongly conclude their branch value survived and act on false merge context.
